How The Book of Mormon connects

  • Event: Tony Awards — The Book of Mormon won Best Musical at the Tony Awards.
  • Topic: Broadway — The Book of Mormon is a 2010s Tony-winning Broadway long run.

What is The Book of Mormon?

The Book of Mormon is the 2011 musical that opened at the Eugene O'Neill, won Best Musical at the Tonys, and sat beside Wicked and later Hamilton as a tourist-proof comedy.

Key threads lead to Tony Awards and Broadway.
